_note: situational spell swaps for the counter screen. Never replace smite; never replace flash unless the build says so. 'build_types' limits a rule to builds of those fine types. 'build_overrides' = fixed spells per champion ('*' = all builds) or 'Champion|build id'. 'Champion|build id|LANE' overrides the spells_by_lane entry of a shared JUNGLE+other-lane build; the build's own `spells` stays the JUNGLE entry (smite).

rules.reason_ar: يعتمد {n} من الأعداء على العلاج — Ignite يقلّل علاجهم
rules.reason_en: {n} enemies rely on healing — Ignite cuts their healing

rules.reason_ar: يستطيع {n} من الأعداء قتلك بكومبو واحد — Exhaust يضعف ضرر أحدهم
rules.reason_en: {n} enemies can burst you — Exhaust weakens one of them

rules.reason_ar: يملك {n} من الأعداء تحكماً (CC) كثيراً — Cleanse يزيل التحكم عنك
rules.reason_en: {n} enemies have heavy crowd control — Cleanse removes it

rules.reason_ar: يضرب {n} من الأعداء ضرباً متواصلاً — Exhaust يقلّل ضرر أخطرهم
rules.reason_en: {n} enemies deal sustained damage — Exhaust cuts the worst one

rules.reason_ar: أغلب ضرر العدو فيزيائي ({n} من 5) — Barrier يمتص جزءاً من الضرر
rules.reason_en: Most enemy damage is physical ({n}/5) — Barrier absorbs some of it
